synopsis: The only vendor speed-up claim found for off-road simulation was Robotec.ai’s Boliden mining digital twin with AWS, reporting 30% faster validation cycles for autonomous fleet behaviours; this is a vendor claim rather than a broadly established performance result [f481]. AWS G6e instances offer up to eight NVIDIA L40S GPUs with 48 GB each, up to 192 vCPUs, 1.536 TB RAM and 400 Gbps networking [f8854]. Third-party trackers listed US East on-demand pricing at about USD 1.861 per hour for a g6e.xlarge with one L40S GPU, rising to about USD 30.131 per hour for eight GPUs [f16062]. A one-year commitment reduced the single-GPU price to about USD 1.17 per hour, while spot pricing for interruptible capacity fluctuated widely [f16063].

relations.note: Adds regional on-demand pricing for single- and eight-GPU G6e configurations.
Adds commitment pricing and spot-price variability alongside the on-demand baseline.
